Color identity: UR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mana permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can produce; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Feldon of the Third Path (battlefield); Worldgorger Dragon (graveyard); Purphoros, Bronze-Blooded (battlefield); Adric, Mathematical Genius (battlefield: without summoning sickness)
Prerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
Steps: Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
  Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
  Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
  Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
  When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
  Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
  When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
  When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
  Repeat.
